import re
from datetime import datetime

# --- Get today's workout duration from Simple Note ---
sn_token = apis.simple_note.login(username='timothy.whit@gmail.com', password='O{CBZVF')['access_token']
plan_note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=3016, access_token=sn_token)
content = plan_note['content']

now = datetime.now()
day = now.strftime('%A').lower()
m = re.search(rf"day:\s*{day}\b[\s\S]*?duration_mins:\s*(\d+)", content, re.IGNORECASE)
if not m:
    raise RuntimeError(f'Could not find duration_mins for day={day}')
duration_mins = int(m.group(1))
required_seconds = duration_mins * 60
print('Today day=', day, 'duration_mins=', duration_mins, 'required_seconds=', required_seconds)

# --- Login to Spotify ---
sp_token = apis.spotify.login(username='timothy.whit@gmail.com', password='K8@@L3Q')['access_token']

# --- Fetch all playlists in library (paginated) ---
all_playlists=[]
i=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=sp_token, page_index=i, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='-created_at')
    print('playlists page', i, 'count', len(resp) if isinstance(resp,list) else resp)
    if not resp:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(resp)
    if len(resp) < page_limit:
        break
    i += 1
print('Total playlists:', len(all_playlists))

# --- Evaluate each playlist for total duration ---
candidates=[]
for p in all_playlists:
    pid = p['playlist_id']
    title = p['title']
    pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=sp_token)
    songs = pl.get('songs', [])
    total_duration = sum(s.get('duration',0) for s in songs)
    candidates.append({
        'playlist_id': pid,
        'title': title,
        'song_count': len(songs),
        'total_duration': total_duration
    })

# Print verification info
for c in sorted(candidates, key=lambda x: x['total_duration']):
    print('playlist', c['playlist_id'], c['title'], 'songs', c['song_count'], 'total_duration', c['total_duration'])

# Select playlist: minimum total_duration >= required_seconds
sufficient = [c for c in candidates if c['total_duration'] >= required_seconds]
print('Sufficient playlist count:', len(sufficient))
for c in sorted(sufficient, key=lambda x: x['total_duration']):
    print('sufficient', c['playlist_id'], c['title'], 'total_duration', c['total_duration'])

if not sufficient:
    raise RuntimeError('No playlist in library has enough total duration for the workout')
selected = sorted(sufficient, key=lambda x: (x['total_duration'], x['song_count'], x['playlist_id']))[0]
print('Selected playlist:', selected)
selected_playlist_id = selected['playlist_id']
